question: Which medical term describes an eating disorder in which energy expenditure is restricted below requirements, leading to significant weight loss?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anorexia Nervosa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anorexia Nervosa** is a type of eating disorder characterized by the restriction of **energy intake**, resulting in significantly low body weight relative to age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.
 
• It involves an **intense fear of gaining weight** or becoming fat, even though the individual is underweight. This fear leads to severe food restriction and unhealthy behaviors related to eating.
 
• People with anorexia nervosa may have a **distorted body image**, perceiving themselves as overweight even when they are dangerously thin.
 
• This disorder affects both males and females, though it is more commonly observed in **adolescent females**.
 
• Anorexia Nervosa can lead to severe health complications, including **cardiac issues, osteoporosis, anemia, and multi-organ failure**, if left untreated.
